name: Rest Ez Inc.
summary: Rest Ez Inc. specializes in the production and distribution of sleep-enhancing soft gel capsules throughout the United States. The company's flagship product, also named "Rest EZ," is a soft gel dietary supplement formulated to aid sleep. These offerings are made accessible to consumers via a multi-channel sales strategy, encompassing both wholesale and retail partnerships, as well as direct purchases through its dedicated e-commerce website, www.RestEz.net. Established in 2016, Rest Ez Inc. operates from its headquarters located in Riverton, Utah.
